basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex, a 27-year-old software developer from Melbourne, Australia. I started using Reddit in April 2023 as a way to connect with others during my daily commutes and late-night coding sessions. I'm particularly interested in technology and philosophy, which aligns with my frequent visits to subreddits like 'Concordia' and 'thelema'. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the Australian outdoors or diving into the latest video games. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the software development industry for the past 5 years. My expertise lies in developing scalable web applications, and I'm constantly learning new frameworks and technologies through online courses and community forums.
